summary.text: Howard Marklein is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 17 since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A certified public accountant, he chairs the Senate Finance Committee and co-chairs the Joint Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Howard Marklein earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater in 1976 and became a certified public accountant in 1978.
He has been a partner at Baker Tilly (formerly Virchow Krause) since 1984 and works in forensic accounting and white collar crime investigation.
Marklein represented Assembly District 51 before moving to the Senate, where he assumed office on January 5, 2015.

In the 2025-2026 session he co-chairs the Joint Finance Committee, chairs the Senate Finance Committee, and serves on the Joint Legislative Audit, Joint Legislative Council, Agriculture and Revenue, and Employment Relations committees.
